name: IdleAttractManager
src_typeComment: Detects a period of no user input (mouse/touch/key) and fires OnIdleStarted — wire that to an attract loop (idle video/slideshow) and/or a "return to home screen" action. Any input resets the idle timer and fires OnIdleEnded exactly once per idle period, not on every input frame. Uses the legacy Input class directly (mouse/touch/keyboard) rather than the New Input System, matching this project's LegacyInputManager default — swap the input-detection block if a project uses the New Input System.

src_serialized.name: idleTimeout
src_serialized.tooltip: Seconds of no input before idle/attract mode begins.

src_members.sig: public bool IsIdle { get; private set; }
src_members.name: IsIdle
NotifyInput
src_members.comment: Resets the idle timer and, if currently idle, ends idle mode — split out from Update()'s real Input polling specifically so a self-test can drive this directly without depending on real Input state (which isn't meaningfully controllable from a batch-mode Editor script). Also useful directly for a "Tap to Start" attract-screen button that should dismiss immediately.

src_members.name: Tick
src_members.comment: Public so a self-test can drive the idle timeout with exact time increments without needing Play mode.
